system.description:
Caine's curse resonates strongly in your bones, but it grants a proven advantage: you are connected to the soil of your prime haven, granting an extra die to all dice pools when operating there. It also acts as a mystic beacon, letting you home in on its location with a standard Perception + Survival roll (difficulty 6; +1 difficulty if a state or country separates you from it, +2 if you're halfway across the globe). This applies only to your prime haven, not any auxiliary shelters.

MET System: Spend a Mental Trait and engage in a Simple Challenge with the Storyteller. If successful, you earn a bonus Trait in all challenges initiated within your haven, as well as feeling a spiritual tug toward its direction. If your haven is a great distance away, the Storyteller may instead have you make a Hand Test and spend a Willpower Trait rather than a Mental Trait, reflecting the strong mystical connection to your distant prime haven.
system.source: Clanbook: Tzimisce, Chapter Two: Ego and Evolution
